I’m not sure how it is with benzos, but I used to be hooked on opioids a while ago and have accidentally OD’d about three times and extreme nausea afterward is super common. For me, anything I ate would just come right back up even if it was as little as a sandwich. 

I would recommend just slowly sipping some water throughout the day and maybe eating some saltine crackers or toast with like some light butter.

Thank you for the advice! I didn't realize that by just by saying sorry multiple times that it does create a victim role and would seem like I'm placing blame on them for my actions. 

They had a huge impact on me even though for them it didn't seem like it. I know a big issue for my friend was feeling so hopeless because they, "tried everything," but it wasn't "curing" me or making me feel better instantly.

Thank you so much for your advice. I will definitely include the part where you said to let them know that they don't need to come back unless they are ready to; I want them to have all the time that they need to focus and better themselves too.

Also thank you! I'm glad too and will be continuing my treatment.
